# Statements GetObjects sends at this depth, sorted. Regenerate with -update.

## no filters: 3 statement(s), 1 IN ACCOUNT
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ DATABASES IN ACCOUNT
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ SCHEMAS IN DATABASE "OBJ1"
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ SCHEMAS IN DATABASE "OBJ2"

## plain names DB/SCH/TBL: 2 statement(s), 1 IN ACCOUNT
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ DATABASES LIKE 'DB' IN ACCOUNT
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ SCHEMAS LIKE 'SCH' IN DATABASE "DB"

## underscore names MY_DB/MY_SCH/MY_TBL: 2 statement(s), 1 IN ACCOUNT
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ DATABASES LIKE 'MY_DB' IN ACCOUNT
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ SCHEMAS LIKE 'MY_SCH' IN DATABASE "MY_DB"

## underscore catalog only MY_DB: 2 statement(s), 1 IN ACCOUNT
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ DATABASES LIKE 'MY_DB' IN ACCOUNT
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ SCHEMAS IN DATABASE "MY_DB"

## underscore names matching two databases MULTI_DB/MY_SCH/MY_TBL: 3 statement(s), 1 IN ACCOUNT
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ DATABASES LIKE 'MULTI_DB' IN ACCOUNT
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ SCHEMAS LIKE 'MY_SCH' IN DATABASE "MULTI-DB"
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ SCHEMAS LIKE 'MY_SCH' IN DATABASE "MULTIXDB"

## underscore names matching no database NO_DB/MY_SCH/MY_TBL: 1 statement(s), 1 IN ACCOUNT
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ DATABASES LIKE 'NO_DB' IN ACCOUNT

## underscore names matching 20 databases MANY_DB/MY_SCH/MY_TBL: 3 statement(s), 2 IN ACCOUNT
    <queries/get_objects_dbschemas.sql>
        CATALOG="MANY_DB" DB_SCHEMA="MY_SCH" TABLE="MY_TBL" COLUMN="%" PK_QUERY_ID="" FK_QUERY_ID="" UNIQUE_QUERY_ID="" SHOW_DB_QUERY_ID="<id>" SHOW_SCHEMA_QUERY_ID="<id>" SHOW_TABLE_QUERY_ID="" SHOW_COLUMNS_QUERY_ID=""
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ DATABASES LIKE 'MANY_DB' IN ACCOUNT
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ SCHEMAS LIKE 'MY_SCH' IN ACCOUNT

## percent patterns DB%/SCH%/TBL%: 3 statement(s), 1 IN ACCOUNT
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ DATABASES LIKE 'DB%' IN ACCOUNT
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ SCHEMAS LIKE 'SCH%' IN DATABASE "OBJ1"
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ SCHEMAS LIKE 'SCH%' IN DATABASE "OBJ2"

    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ SCHEMAS LIKE 'SCH' IN DATABASE "DB"

    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ SCHEMAS LIKE 'SCH' IN DATABASE "DB"

## match exactly MY_DB/MY_SCH/MY_TBL: 2 statement(s), 1 IN ACCOUNT
